scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:cpp && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.build:cpp: cmake -S cpp -B cpp/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build cpp/build --config Release
scripts.test: npm run test:cpp && npm run test -w server
scripts.test:cpp: npm run build:cpp && ctest --test-dir cpp/build -C Release --output-on-failure
